notes: Supplier (AP) payments keyed by refNbr. currency is a nested {id,description} object here (DIFFERS from customer_payments where currency is a plain string). supplier is a nested {internalId,number,name} object — use supplier.number as FK to visma_suppliers. released=true means posted to GL (use to exclude drafts). unappliedBalance>0 means overpayment/credit remaining. paymentLines[] links to settled supplier invoices. type values: AP/PP/DR. documentType, paymentRef, paymentMethod, cashAccount exist in the DTO but are never populated for these tenants. Primary key is (type, refNbr), not refNbr alone: a Prepayment and its VoidPayment share a refNbr (25 collisions in 9,132 rows), and refNbr-only made validation reject the whole endpoint. OPEN DISCREPANCY (measured 2026-09-29): DataMart supplierPayments holds 9,163 payments vs 9,132 from /v1/supplierpayment (the API's own totalCount). The 31 extra are all Payment / status Printed / released=false, created 2026-05-08..2026-09-23; the 90 unreleased Printed payments the ERP does return are all newer (2026-09-15..09-28). Cause not established (not status, branch, currency or method). Every ERP row exists in DataMart. DataMart apPayments is an identical alias of supplierPayments. DataMart normalizer parity vs ERP on 9,132 shared keys: 15 of 23 ERP fields equal, currency and supplier match on id only, ZERO wrong values. Missing on DataMart's SupplierPayment root: balance (NOT equal to unappliedBalance on 90 rows, so not derived), branch, location code, cashAccount code (only the internal id), paymentLines, timeStamp.
